$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: FSL-1.1-ALv2 — Card state contract v1 for Tradvia v0.1

BACKLOG.description: Card exists and is prioritized; nobody is working on it.

AGENT_WORKING.description: Agents are planning, coding in the sandbox or testing.

WAITING_HUMAN.description: An agent asked a question and paused the run until a human answers.

IN_REVIEW_PR.description: A pull request is open and checks or human review are pending.

DONE.description: Pull request merged. Card is closed with cost and time recorded.

card_metadata.title: string
card_metadata.description: string — the task as written by the human
card_metadata.plan: array<object> — subtasks written by @Agent-Architect: { id, title, done }
card_metadata.pending_question: object | null — { asked_by, text, channel, asked_at }
card_metadata.run_id: string | null — orchestrator thread id, used to resume after WAITING_HUMAN
card_metadata.cost: object — { usd: number, tokens_in: number, tokens_out: number, by_model: object }
card_metadata.history: array<object> — every transition: { from, to, by, reason, at }

transitions.trigger: Human moves the card or assigns it to an agent
Agent is blocked, uncertain, or reached an approval gate
side_effects: Post the question to Slack/Discord with a link to the card

transitions.trigger: Human answers or replies 'Aprovado' / 'Approved' in the chat
side_effects: Resume the orchestrator run from run_id

transitions.trigger: @Agent-Reviewer passed tests and @Agent-Coder opened a pull request
Changes requested on the PR or checks failed
Human cancels or deprioritizes the card

rules: Only humans move a card into AGENT_WORKING from BACKLOG and into DONE.
An agent never merges a pull request.
A card in WAITING_HUMAN has exactly one pending_question.
Every transition appends one entry to history.
